summary: Flat, tree-shaded kerb near the top; homes 15-25 m off all round.
reasons: Homes within about 25 m on both sides
Bushy garden screens the north side

best_section.where: Shaded mid-block on the north kerb, past the parked cars

drivers.seclusion: North side backs onto leafy gardens with houses roughly 15-27 m back; houses across the road about 18-21 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with trees overhanging; cars park at the east end, so kerb room is plausible but the lane is narrow.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, close to the junction at the west end.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; a few cars parked at 0-30 m. No campers seen.

flags: Steep at the east end: max grade 19.1%
sun_shade: Dense canopy overhead; shaded most of the day.
